svg.title: AREA 36
svg.desc: Count spare weapons after two rooms. Four allow the north shortcut, one per pad; otherwise take 2 without wasting time farming. Warp 1 is an optional box detour; return to the main route afterward. After 2, turn on the light; at the paired warps choose left 3, not side-room 4. Turrets guard the bend after 3; run through along the route without stopping in their firing line. One can collect the hall boxes. North warps 6/7 and extra box rooms are optional; skip when racing the clock. Avoid the hanging jar trap in the hallway. The equipment-gated healing ring afterward is optional; keep the party moving. The late dark-room light is under the poison jar; deal with it before lighting and clearing the room. Normally skip the turret-guarded box room near the exit.
